verdict.rationale: Any online service that collects user-submitted data, including a state filing portal with credentialed accounts, could plausibly publish an AI-training or data-use policy, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no AI-training policy, opt-out control, or data-use statement for user data. The Radware bot wall on the front door is generic anti-bot protection, not a user-facing control over AI training, and the sale of bulk data subscriptions is not evidence of any AI-training opt-out.
